## Checklist

- [ ] Required checks pass (CodeQL, dependency review, and CI once it exists).
- [ ] No secrets in code, logs, screenshots or URLs.
- [ ] Fetched content (filings, news, web) is treated as untrusted data and can't change instructions or trigger actions.
- [ ] Model output is shown as plain text, with links to sources.
- [ ] New dependencies are real, maintained, widely used and spelled correctly.
- [ ] Data sources' terms and rate limits are respected.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes had an independent review.
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated if users would notice.
